title: Analyzing values about gendered language reform in LLMs’ revisions

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting LLMs to revise sentences containing masculine, feminine, and gender-neutral role nouns while manipulating the referent's explicit gender (man, woman, nonbinary) and pronouns (he/him, she/her, they/them). The study evaluates the models' revision choices (e.g., rates of neutralization) and analyzes the textual justifications provided by the models to see if they align with feminist and trans-inclusive language reforms or reinforce gender stereotypes based on the sentence context.
